label: Evapotranspiration, monthly (MODIS)
source: MODIS MOD16A2GF v061 (Terra, 8-day, gap-filled) via NASA AppEEARS
aggregation: 8-day ET totals prorated to calendar months by day overlap (last composite of each year is 5/6 days), per ~1 km cell; then mean of valid cells in county
notes: Actual ET (Penman-Monteith MOD16). Open water, urban and barren pixels are fill and excluded (e.g. the permanent Sudd open water), so wetland counties are under-represented. Cells need >=75% of month's days valid. Annual sums vs MOD16A3GF modis_et_mm: r=1.0, ratio 0.9999. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.

label: NDVI, monthly 1 km (MODIS MOD13A3)
source: MODIS MOD13A3 v061 (Terra monthly 1 km) via NASA AppEEARS
aggregation: monthly composite (pixel reliability good/marginal), mean of valid ~1 km cells in county
notes: Different compositing from modis_ndvi (MOD13A3 is a weighted average of 16-day 1 km composites; modis_ndvi is the Terra+Aqua 500 m monthly maximum), so kept as a separate id; MOD13A3 runs lower. Covers Aug-Oct 2025 missing from the Planetary Computer series. Overlap vs existing modis_ndvi (93 months): r=0.991, mean bias -0.0343. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.

label: EVI, monthly 1 km (MODIS MOD13A3)

notes: See modis13a3_ndvi. Overlap vs existing modis_evi (93 months): r=0.988, mean bias -0.0307. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.

label: Land surface temperature, day (MODIS, AppEEARS copy)
source: MODIS MOD11A2 v061 (Terra) via NASA AppEEARS
aggregation: same as modis_lst_day_c (QC good/other, error<=2K, month of composite mid-date, per-cell mean, county mean)
notes: 2022-2025 only; hidden duplicate used to verify and gap-fill modis_lst_day_c. Overlap vs existing modis_lst_day_c (43 months): r=0.9981, mean bias -0.0122. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.

label: Burned area (MODIS MCD64A1, AppEEARS copy)

notes: Hidden duplicate used to verify and gap-fill burned_area_km2. County-months with <50% mapped area dropped. Overlap vs existing burned_area_km2 (90 months): r=1.0, mean bias +0.7034. AppEEARS area request clipped to the South Sudan outline, geographic projection.
